Tag guide

How to read the idea, wording, source, and editorial tags.

I · Idea
Who contributed the idea expressed in this span.

W · Wording
Who supplied the wording. Human wording stays human when AI only cleans or rephrases it; substantive new writing is assessed separately.

Ed · Editorial
Edited by Human or AI: cleanup or rephrasing of supplied wording. This is a separate contribution, not shared wording authorship.

Source · N / F / R
Novel, other fiction, or research. A borrowed premise differs from an original application of it.

Direction · Research request
Who asked for the prior-art search. This credits research direction separately from who found each source, who originated its ideas, or who wrote the passage.

← Introduced by
Who brought that source into this piece. This credits source selection, not authorship of the source.

H Human · A AI · H+A Both · E External · ? Unresolved. A trailing ~ means provisional. Shared requires substantive contributions, not just approval.

Example: a novel-derived premise
I: ExternalW: AISource: NovelIntroduced by Human
The novel supplies the premise; the human brings it into the argument; AI composes this wording. An original analogy using that novel can still have a human idea tag.

Hover over a span to see its tags, or focus it with the keyboard. On touchscreens, tap to show and tap elsewhere to dismiss. The examples below show the three visual cues.

Idea backgroundBackground color shows idea origin.
Wording underlineUnderline color shows wording origin.
Provisional attributionDashes mark provisional attribution.

Contribution summary

WIWA: Whose Idea Was It Anyway?

Introduced by

Research direction

Distinct research requests, counted once across all linked spans. Associated works are counted once per request. These counts are not shares of authorship.

Attribution evidence

Supported means attribution support, not factual validation. It can come from drafting records or an identified author confirmation. Provisional means a gap remains in the contribution history. Claim accuracy is recorded separately in Sources and factual checks.

TagSupported attributionProvisional ~Unresolved

A span can have more than one provisional tag. The headline counts each affected span once.

Counts describe tagged spans of unequal length, not shares of authorship or ownership. Provisional labels are included in the breakdowns. Editorial counts overlap the origin counts; they are not additional spans.

Tags describe contributions to this piece. They do not establish independent invention, measure intelligence, or assign legal ownership.

Contribution counts describe annotated text spans.

Escape or tap outside to dismiss.
